The '''Firaxa''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Praxon]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Praxon Firaxa was a player mount in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> It was added to the game in Game Update 1.2 as a rare reward obtainable during the [[Battle of Denova|Explosive Conflict]] operation.<ref name="operation">{{TORcite|type=operation|Explosive Conflict}}</ref>
